covered_report_window: Monday, October 26, 2026 after the U.S. market close through Tuesday, October 27, 2026 before the U.S. market open.
market_context_summary: The FOMC meeting begins Tuesday ahead of Wednesday's decision; durable-goods, home-price, new-home-sales and consumer-confidence data arrive Tuesday. Elevated oil prices, inflation concerns and high Treasury yields raise the bar for cyclicals and premium valuations.

methodology.disparity_definition: Mean of the average pairwise absolute differences in direction and reversal-risk scores, on a 0-100 scale; lower means tighter agreement.
methodology.lessons_review: Standing timing, single-KPI, premium-growth priced-in and low-bar reversal-risk rules applied; no new method change.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Preannounced sequential earnings improvement and stronger steel-products pricing favor upside if Q4 mill commentary stays firm.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Public consensus is about $5.7-$5.8 EPS; Nucor already said steel-products earnings should improve while raw materials weaken.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Realized pricing and steel-products volumes beat the guide; Q4 demand remains constructive.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: The print only matches the preannouncement and lower raw-material earnings or costs dominate.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options implied move was not reliably available; repurchases support positioning but the preannouncement limits surprise.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Company guidance, rather than scattered sell-side revisions, is the strongest current estimate signal.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record backlog supports a modest upside bias, but premium AI expectations require stronger guidance, not merely an in-range quarter.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Fee-based revenue, member growth and guide

ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q2 raised non-GAAP TM-dollar and EPS guidance, which sets a higher quality bar for Q3.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Amazon mix reset can create margin relief

ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Volume declines outrun cost removal and management trims the margin outlook.
